M.name: Mouth (≈ MSQ Cabbage Tree Creek (Mouth))

M.name: Toombul (Nudgee Rd)
M.src: BoM gauge 540548 (Kedron Brook at Toombul (Nudgee Rd)): 13 highs/13 lows over 7 days matched to Shorncliffe predictions; HW lag sd 14 min, LW lag sd 16 min

M.name: Tidal limit (est.)
M.src: Generic extrapolation 1.9 km beyond the last calibration: median lag growth of all calibrated QLD places/gauges in this region (HW +2.0, LW +3.2 min/km); at a natural tidal limit highs ≈ 0.15 m lower than downstream and lows drain out (water-starts-rising, like upper Baffle)
